NATIVE-001.summary: Lifecycle commands use the published rer package.
NATIVE-001.was: Commands ran through the bundled node scripts/rer.mjs entry point.
NATIVE-001.now: Commands run through rer; local setup still stops its runtime, dev opens the local owner automatically, and deployment dry-run makes no provider requests.

FIRST-RUN-001.summary: New workspaces are provisioned with a starter assistant and installation mail settings, with a smaller first-run form.
FIRST-RUN-001.was: First-run led to a setup checklist and ordinary workspace creation led with the widget snippet.
FIRST-RUN-001.now: One-screen setup derives optional names and colours. Non-demo workspaces gain a default starter assistant, a mailbox when INBOUND_EMAIL_TOKEN exists and the installation sender until their domain is verified. Explicit creation may send one welcome email; uncertain mail is never replayed. Setup separates owner-only tasks from provisioned settings.

ACTIVATION-001.summary: Setup observes applicable steps automatically and supports durable owner/admin skips.
ACTIVATION-001.was: The empty inbox and Setup showed the same eight-step checklist; validation was explicit and publication counted as a step.
ACTIVATION-001.now: Only Setup loads the observations. Signed-in checks perform bounded non-generative reads, never send mail; GET writes nothing. Published articles do not count. Owner-only steps can be skipped without provider work, remain unconfirmed and leave the denominator; an observation wins and rejected keys remain Needs you. Observation details can be stored without backfilling old receipts.

AI-001.summary: A starter assistant without its provider key leaves new conversations with the team.
AI-001.was: Missing providers failed explicitly when model execution was requested.
AI-001.now: Requested model execution still fails explicitly without a provider; new conversations do not assign a default assistant whose provider has no key. Uncertain attempts remain uncertain and daily ceilings still apply.

agentUpdateInstructions: Update from 0.4.1 while preserving owner customizations, native passwords, actor/project authority and explicit operator Send. Stop dev or preview and back up state and private settings. Install the frozen package-mode dependencies (@runeditrun/rer 0.2.19); v0.4.1 predates package conversion. For a new hosted installation, configure OWNER_EMAIL (the rer deploy secret binding); /auth/bootstrap accepts the private H2H_SETUP_TOKEN once, and rer retires it after a confirmed claim. Existing owners and native local password setup are retained. Apply 120_activation_observations.sql then 121_move_in_categories.sql before starting the updated Worker and before serving traffic. Neither migration rewrites prior application rows; 120 adds a nullable observation field without backfill and 121 changes only category revision triggers. Never reset to upgrade. Existing workspaces and user-edited assistants remain under their existing authority; new-workspace defaults and missing-key assignment do not authorize provider work. Preserve uncertain outcomes, reviewed source ancestry, private import originals, resumable journals, schema-2 manifests and raw payload sidecars. Deliberate uncertain webhook resend can duplicate effects and requires inspection of the receiver. Preserve the accessibility checker HOLD and portable-storage limits. An older 0.3 installation follows OPERATIONS.md first, applying 0109_magic_signins.sql before the updated Worker if missing, then 0110 through 119 in order before these two migrations. The magic_signins table and magic_signins_expiry index retain backup and restore obligations for expiry and consumption state; that migration does not rewrite existing rows, create accounts, send email or configure a provider. Email sign-in requires APP_ORIGIN and password sign-in remains available.
publicReleaseNotes: HappyToHelp 0.5.0 adds Help Scout Inbox v2 and Docs v1 response-body Move in, guarded deliberate resend of uncertain webhooks, and a guided local-agent investigation/fix/observation/reply flow. New workspaces gain a starter assistant and installation mail settings; Setup distinguishes observed settings, owner-only tasks and durable skips. Without an AI key conversations stay with the team. A bounded initial website read retains private knowledge without publishing articles. Re-importing unchanged source preserves native edits; category changes invalidate only affected article ancestry. The workspace has a neutral light canvas and lighter controls. Local development uses the README three-command npm bootstrap/clone/rer dev path without private answers or mail/AI credentials; checkout commands pin @runeditrun/rer 0.2.19. Hosted deployment claims the owner named by OWNER_EMAIL during rer deploy, who then signs in by email (rer signin does not yet work with native sign-in); the native /setup form is recovery only, and rer deploy --remove --yes removes an environment; local password setup remains available. Updating from 0.4.1 requires two migrations, 120_activation_observations.sql and 121_move_in_categories.sql, before the updated Worker starts. Imports and connection/provider journeys use synthetic fixtures; real Help Scout accounts, live Slack, hosted installation, paid-provider execution and timed activation remain unqualified. Accessibility remains on owner HOLD; no WCAG, compliance or FedRAMP conformance is claimed. Backups cover D1/R2, not Durable Object storage; full portable fidelity and hosted operating costs are unestablished. app.happytohelp.com is separate legacy production.
